segments.expected: "My left hem," he said. "That puts the slack on your right. I was told." He did not say by whom. "Hold it down. That's all. If it comes proud under your hand, you bring it in. You don't say so."

segments.expected: The cord went round. One. Two. On the third she saw his hands change over. The left took the long end under, and the right only held.
segments.transcript: The cord went round. One, two. On the third she saw his hands change over. The left took the long end under and the right only held.

segments.expected: "Sealed," said Pike. "Forty-four." He had his palm on the neck. "Ward. Full. It's this winter's skin, and no louder than it ought to be."
segments.transcript: Sealed, said Pike. Forty-four. He had his palm on the neck. Ward. Full. It's this winter's skin and no louder than it ought to be.
